title: The Summoner becomes the Lord of the Void
changes: Your golems are now permanent: one from level 1, a second from level 18 with Twin Bond. They climb back out of the Void 12 seconds after falling, and each one wraps you in the aura of its element. Choose their elements in the new grimoire at the bottom right of your screen. Existing Summoners get all their skill points back for free.

New skill tree in three branches (Golems, Void, Conjuration): Black Hole swallows monsters and enemy projectiles, Void Slip saves you at low life, elemental wisps and Void Blades fight beside you, and three new ultimates (Colossus, Event Horizon, Void Arsenal) spend your Void Essence.
Your staff bolt now goes through a Void portal: longer reach, and it comes out right next to your target. The third hit of the combo bursts on the foes around it.

New look: the Summoner is now a bare-headed warlock in a tailcoat and a long violet scarf that streams behind them as they walk and run. The wisps, portals, black holes, Void Blades, the Arsenal's lance and axe and Void Slip have their own effects and sounds, and every Summoner skill has its own icon.
